title: Power Rankings: Can anyone dethrone champs?
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 21
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Lakers held off Portland, sure, but Bynum's suspension halts the best run of his career. Drew just reached double digits in rebounds in seven straight games, after getting there just 10 times in his first 39 games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Tip your cap to the Spurs whether or not you think they've got enough size to get out of the West. This is their 15th season with at least 55 wins since merging into the NBA in 1976, second only to the Lakers' 19 in that span.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Heat salvaged a 5-6 record from that killer 11-game stretch despite losing the first five of those games. They're suddenly up to 20-20 against teams with records of .500 or better. They're thrilled, basically.

rankings.summaryHtml: You know the saying: As Rondo goes, so goes Boston. So it's no wonder that the Celts are in a 3-4 funk; Rondo has averaged just 6.0 ppg and 6.4 apg, while shooting 31.3 percent from the floor, in those seven games.
